change_record: while a child propagates: the ops (values) whose minimum rose or maximum fell, and the ops that became singletons; built as a side effect of each deletion, read by every consumer

consumers.reuse: parent's fixpoint (every edge satisfied, every non-singleton domain disjoint from the full cycles of the parent's last rule-2 snapshot) and parent's singles map
consumers.rule: evaluate only edges dirtied by the change record, in R0's sweep order (later index: same sweep; earlier: next sweep); rule 2 only on new singletons: EO over their (engine, cycle) keys in sorted order, EF only for NEWLY full cycles, ops in selected order, values in domain order

recompute the contribution of a dynamic value only if an op it reads (producer, consumer) changed; if none changed reuse the parent's peak; else rebuild the difference array from contributions and run R0's segment scan unchanged. Address-phase prunes reuse the time leaf's cached peak (same D)

consumers.reuse: parent's address fixpoint (every pair satisfied) and the leaf's pair incidence
consumers.rule: evaluate only pairs (u, v) whose A_v minimum rose or maximum fell, in R0's sweep order; root call = R0's first sweep with every pair dirty

consumers.reuse: the parent state object is shared by all siblings, read-only
consumers.rule: one dict copy per child (R0 copies twice: children and times_fixpoint)

dependencies_and_invalidation.affected domains: the change record of the child call; every derived fact reads only the domains named in its dependency: edge (u,v) -> max(D_v), min(D_u); rule-2 key (e,c) -> singles; EF op -> newly full cycles of its engine; value interval -> producer bounds and consumer minima; pair (u,v) -> min/max(A_v)
dependencies_and_invalidation.branch / sibling / resume: states are immutable after construction; a child builds a NEW state (copy-on-write of D, A, singles, contrib); siblings and later resumptions read the unchanged parent; DFS backtracking restores by reference, no undo log
dependencies_and_invalidation.fixed context: fixed times/addresses/base usage are Propagation constants (R0's own)
dependencies_and_invalidation.incumbent-sensitive data: only prune's `best`; it is an argument, never cached; PB certificates are emitted by the unchanged comparison
dependencies_and_invalidation.partial times -> fixed lifetimes -> addr: the time leaf's TimeState (with its cached peak) is reused by every address-phase prune of that leaf; address states are rebuilt from the leaf's pairs tuple (PairInfo built once per leaf, charged to the address root)
dependencies_and_invalidation.program / query / epoch: a Propagation is built per query domain (program, window, caps, incumbent epoch); all masks and states belong to it and die with the query; nothing is shared across Propagations or compilations
dependencies_and_invalidation.roots: time root: R0's own times_fixpoint then singles from its output; address root: emulation with every pair dirty (identical to R0's first sweep)

distinct_from.efficiency_M1_rule2_filter: the rejected filter skipped a rule-2 op scan when the domain was disjoint from all full cycles (recomputed each sweep); BS1 never recomputes the singles map or full sets: it derives only NEWLY full cycles from new singletons and reuses everything else from the parent; it also covers precedence, live bounds and address support
distinct_from.next_round_worklist_E1: E1 re-queued edges of changed ops in arbitrary queue order (certificate order changed), kept R0's full rule-2 scan and full compulsory peak, carried no state between parent and child beyond domains; BS1 emulates R0's sweep order exactly (identical certificate stream), and reuses the parent's singles, full-cycle knowledge, interval contributions and peak

kernel_protocol.integration_costs_not_in_kernel: measured in each kernel row: one extra node slot write and one extra method dispatch per event (adapter upper estimate); multiplied by 1.5 with the rest of N in the conservative prediction
kernel_protocol.parity: per event: output digest and emitted-certificate count equal to the capture; final certificate stream digest equal
kernel_protocol.rows: 30 programs x 3 repetitions x 2 versions = 180 fresh processes
kernel_protocol.timed_region: Propagation construction (with the kernel's masks), every event, output release after last use; domain reconstruction and JSON decoding excluded from both

versions.baseline_kernel: research.third_round_workload.replay_baseline (R0's own methods, the child copy included)

kernel_protocol.workload: the 30 captured M0 workloads (hashes in DIAGNOSIS.json), fixed before any kernel timing

keys: no cache keyed by digests or values: reuse is by object reference parent -> child inside the search tree; equality is never inferred from a digest

m0_evidence.per_family_opportunity: scalar/vector/aliasing and most dependency/mixed programs: precedence + issue capacity + live bounds; mixed 800002/800007, dependency 800003/800018, vector 800011/800026, scalar 800010: address support. Programs with little search (800023: 13 events) have almost none and stay in the denominator

name: immutable per-node branch state with a single change record driving four consumers
not_consumers: product_bound's LC loop (recomputed as in R0)
order_and_witnesses: rule order, canonical ranks, tie-breaking and witness selection are R0's: skipped work is exactly work whose R0 evaluation emits nothing and changes nothing (edge satisfied / scan with no full value / unchanged interval); every emitted certificate is produced by the same expression at the same point of R0's order
ordering_disclosure: An unexecuted draft of research/third_round_kernel.py was written while the M0 rows were being measured, before this file. It had not been imported, run or timed when this specification was written; its sha256 at this moment is recorded under kernel_source_at_spec. Any later change to it is a correctness fix within this design and is retained in KERNEL_ATTEMPTS.jsonl.

prediction.N: shared-kernel replay median + measured integration upper estimate
prediction.O: exclusively owned replaced R0 work per program = min(baseline-kernel replay median, timer-exclusive replaced seconds / timer inflation); must satisfy 0 <= O <= T0
prediction.aggregate: equal-family geometric mean of T_pred/T0 over all 30 programs (zero-call programs contribute 1)
prediction.gate: conservative ratio <= 0.80 and kernel parity on all 30 workloads; else NO_JUSTIFIED_MECHANISM

AddressState.info: PairInfo of the time leaf's pairs tuple: for each value v, the bitmask of pair indices whose SECOND element is v

representation.Propagation extras (per query domain, bu: in_mask[op] (edges (w, op)), out_mask[op] (edges (op, w)), engine_of, values_of[op] (dynamic value indices whose interval reads op's bounds)

TimeState.D: time domains of the node (the same sorted tuples R0 keeps; no new value-set encoding)
TimeState.contrib: compulsory-lifetime contribution (start_hi, end_lo, width) or None per dynamic value, in R0's dynamic_values order
TimeState.parent/changed: transient: parent state and the set of ops whose domain differs from the parent's, dropped once contrib is derived
TimeState.singles: selected singleton issues per (engine, cycle), equal to R0's last rule-2 snapshot of the node

representation.bitmaps: Python ints over CONSTRAINT indices of one Propagation (edges) or one pairs tuple (pairs); never over value sets, never a codec free-coordinate mask, no complement is taken (only the sub-mask m ^ (m >> (i+1) << (i+1)) of a mask m); width = len(edges) or len(pairs); no full-program assignment is enumerated

storage_and_eviction: per live node: one D dict (R0 also keeps one), one singles dict (new only when new singletons appear), one contrib list (len(dynamic_values)); per address node one A dict; per time leaf one PairInfo; freed with the node (no eviction policy needed: lifetime = node lifetime; frontier bounded by R0's 4096 limit)
written_before: any kernel execution, parity check or timing (see ordering_disclosure)
